revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - See Hoogendijk's comments re: ln 5. The text should be tagged, as she says <:ὅσων|reg|ὅσον=PN M. Zellmann-Rohrer (digital image)|ed|ὅσων:>. In ln 9 add Hoogendijk's correct markup <:βεβαιώσω|reg|βεβαιώσωι=PN F.A.J. Hoogendijk (digital image)|ed|βεβαιώσω:>. Hoogendijk's suggestion for ln 6 <:<:κασσιτεροποιοῦ|reg|χασιδηροποις=PN F.A.J. Hoogendijk (digital image)|ed|:<κασσιτεροποιοῦ|reg|κασιδηροποις:>:> is good, although the the first two letters, χα, appear to have been formed ex corr. Should this be noted?

Vote - AcceptText - l. 5: I agree with the new reading, but the correction l. ὅσοι is wrong, ὅσων is the expected form. The correction l. ὅσοι in DDBDP-text does not reflect the original edition and should be deleted. So I suggest to change into <:ὅσων|reg|ὅσον=PN M. Zellmann-Rohrer (digital image)|ed|ὅσων:> l. 9: accept MZR's new reading add for l. 9: change first βεβαιώσω into <:βεβαιώσω|reg|βεβαιώσωι=PN F.A.J. Hoogendijk (digital image)|ed|βεβαιώσω:> add for l. 6: change into <:<:κασσιτεροποιοῦ|reg|χασιδηροποις=PN F.A.J. Hoogendijk (digital image)|ed|:<κασσιτεροποιοῦ|reg|κασιδηροποις:>:> [APIS-link to images did not work; see images on http://quod.lib.umich.edu/a/apis/x-3100/731R_A.TIF?chaperone=S-APIS-X-3100+731R.TIF;evl=full-image;quality=0;resnum=;subview=detail;view=entry and http://quod.lib.umich.edu/a/apis/x-3100/731R_B.TIF?chaperone=S-APIS-X-3100+731R.TIF;evl=full-image;quality=1;resnum=;subview=detail;view=entry]

Vote - ReturnToSender - Please take a look at the following files in papyri.info: papyri.info/ddbdp/sb;22;15336; papyri.info/ddbdp/p.vind.sal;;7; papyri.info/ddbdp/p.oxy;8;112; papyri.info/ddbdp/sb;20;15020. If you click on the Editorial history and look at the submission notes it will indicate to you how we would like to enter these types of correction.
Vote - ReturnToSender - In the submission comments box please explain in more detail what has been changed and why.
